meta.title: Friday Night Paper Fight - Commander Planechase
meta.format: Commander + PLANECHASE variant (CR 901), 4-player, 40 life, shared planar deck (~80 planes, phenomena removed)
meta.variant_notes: FIRST NON-STANDARD-VARIANT SAMPLE in the dataset. Shared single planar deck (one of the sanctioned options), planes shown digitally by Paul (off-screen judge/operator). House choices: no phenomena; occasional reroll allowances for dice off the table.

eliminations.cause: Act of Treason on his own Wurm + Brion Fling (steal-sac-throw line)

result.winner: Graham (Brion Stoutarm) by concession - LOW confidence; alternate reading: Adam (Goreclaw)
result.note: Final minutes heavily garbled; 3:48:22 someone concedes after Stalking Vengeance + topdecked Boros Charm (both Graham's colors) are discussed

meta.extraction_method: YouTube auto-generated captions (ASR, unlabeled). Segments pre-filtered by game-keyword before capture (781 pure-banter segments dropped). Condensed key-event log.

planechase_rules_observed.detail: Setup explained: 6-sided planar die (1 Planeswalker face, 1 chaos face, 4 blank); one free roll per turn, each additional roll costs 1 more generic mana; sorcery timing (main phase, stack empty)

'Rolling the die does not use the stack - you can't respond to the die roll - but the [chaos/planeswalk] ability it triggers goes on the stack.' Matches CR: the roll itself doesn't use the stack; resulting triggered abilities do
Shared-single-planar-deck option chosen over per-player decks ('funnier and more wacky')

Planes identified: Dark Barony (nonblack card to graveyard = lose 1), Academy at Tolaria West (empty hand at end step = draw 7), The Great Forest (creatures assign damage equal to toughness), Furnace Layer (random player discards, land discard = lose 3), Feeding Grounds (R/G spells cheaper, chaos = +1/+1 counters), Mount Keralia (pressure counters, damage on leave), Tazeem (creatures can't block), Kharasha Foothills (attack copies vs each other opponent, chaos = sac creatures for damage), 'bird town' plane (noncreature spells countered -> X 1/1 Birds), Naar Isle (flame counters, damage on chaos), Glimmervoid Basin (all instants/sorceries copied), Quicksilver Sea (scry 4, chaos = free cast off top), a frozen plane (lands don't untap)

key_events.detail: Roll-off d20: Ian 18, goes first... (attribution loose); free mulligan discussion; commanders in command zone

key_events.card: Malevolent Whispers (steal Adam's Avenger of Zendikar) -> attack -> FLING it at Adam's face via Brion
key_events.detail: 14 damage + card advantage; the deck's signature line. Mimic Vat imprints the dying Avenger (23:33)
Mimic Vat imprint: reveal required, works on ANY nontoken creature dying, token copies exiled later; 1:31:56 CMC of X-spell copy on the stack discussion
The Great Forest plane: 0/1 tokens deal combat damage equal to TOUGHNESS - plane text overrides normal damage assignment while active

Furnace Layer: 'select target player at RANDOM, that player discards' - table correctly notes the PLAYER is random but the discard is a CHOICE, and it can hit the roller ('that's not opponent, that's player')
Steals Adam's wurm (act of treason effect), attacks Adam with it, Brion FLINGS it -> ADAM ELIMINATED (~54:20, game 1's first kill)

GOAD worked through correctly: goaded creature attacks each combat if able, must attack a player other than the goader; on its controller's own turn it can attack anyone except the goader; with one opponent dead it can only attack the remaining non-goader

PERSIST vs Mimic Vat ordering on double-blocked Woodfall Primus: persist correctly identified as replacement-flavored trigger on death with no -1/-1 counters; simultaneous death triggers ordered by controller. FLAG: table concluded 'person who controls the creature when it dies controls the persisted creature' - CR 702.79a says it returns under its OWNER's control. In this game state owner=controller so no material error, but the stated rule is imprecise
Two Sun Titans + Strip Mine: first Titan (already attacked) gets only its later trigger; ETB vs attack triggers distinguished cleanly per object; Strip Mine recursion loop executed correctly

'Bird town': noncreature spells countered -> caster gets X 1/1 Birds (X=MV). Correctly ruled: counter-and-replace happens from the plane's static/triggered text; lands aren't spells so land drops unaffected (echoes game_003's lesson)

'Tokens DO go to the graveyard (then cease to exist)' - so Soulcatchers' Aerie gets feather counters from token birds dying; Kharasha Foothills' copies EXILE instead so those don't trigger it; Deadwood Treefolk 'leaves play' trigger fires regardless of destination. Sharp zone-change reasoning throughout
Damage from Graham's sources to opponents DOUBLED; combined with Inferno Titan + Kharasha Foothills copy-attackers

Plane-created token copy of Inferno Titan: table works through which triggers each object gets. They granted the token an 'attack trigger' - FLAG: creatures PUT onto the battlefield attacking were never DECLARED as attackers, so 'whenever ~ attacks' abilities do NOT trigger for them (only real ETB triggers apply). Partial error in a complex stack
IAN ELIMINATED (game 1) - doubled Titan damage; 800.4a implications acknowledged ('it resolves, Ian leaves the game, this bird dies')
GRAHAM WINS game 1 (medium confidence); table immediately opts for game 2: 'I'm happy to play another game... Paul, where we started'
Same four decks; new plane gives 'play any number of lands' -> explosive Boros Garrison/Hammer of Purphoros opening for Graham
Top-card-revealed plane: 'spells that share a type with your top card can't be cast'; correctly ruled lands still playable ('you don't cast lands') - third occurrence of this lesson in the dataset
'I lose one mana to the aether' - unused floating mana empties at step/phase end (and the missed opportunity to spend it on a planar reroll)

Quicksilver Sea chaos: 'top card is an island - go for it, house rule' - free-cast of a land allowed by table fiat ('you may PLAY it' actually covers lands; their instinct was right, labeled house rule unnecessarily)
Golgari Charm regenerate-all in response; Brion untaps via Thornbite Staff after sac ('two triggers: draw off Lokhust?/the wurm, Brion untaps from the staff') - staff untap engine online

Glimmervoid Basin: every instant/sorcery copied, copies may choose new targets. 2:54:58 Deflecting Palm cast AND copied - double redirect. 2:58:30 Rending Vines copied: 'one of them is going to target [my own] - I know' - forced copy targeting handled
Life-payment check: 'do I just die if I pay 10?' - you can't pay more life than you have, paying down to low totals is legal (they debated Phyrexian Processor payments)
Gisela doubling + lifelink: doubled damage means doubled lifelink gain - source deals the (doubled) damage, lifelink sees the full amount

Trample assignment under The Great Forest (toughness-assigns-damage plane): attacker must still assign LETHAL to each blocker before excess tramples through - '2, 4 and 2... so 3 tramples over... which becomes 6 [Gisela]'

key_events.card: Siege Behemoth (hexproof, creatures may assign damage as though unblocked)
key_events.detail: Adam's board goes wide + unblockable-ish; frozen-lands plane strands blockers ('your lands don't untap... creatures don't freeze')

Chaos: 'draw a card for each land you control' - 9 cards; 'I think I just won the game'; Stalking Vengeance + Settle the Wreckage topdeck talk; 3:48:22 CONCESSION ends game 2. Winner attribution LOW confidence (Graham per Boros Charm/Stalking Vengeance colors; alternate: Adam)

verified_correct: Planar die mechanics: free roll, escalating cost, sorcery timing, roll bypasses stack but triggered abilities use it (901.3a, 901.8, 901.9)
Goad restrictions incl. two-player edge case (701.15)
Tokens hit the graveyard then cease to exist; exile-instead effects skip death triggers (111.7-111.8)
Lands are played, not cast - now confirmed on three separate planes/games (305.9)
Copy effects with new targets (Glimmervoid Basin, 707.10)
Trample lethal-assignment under altered damage rules (702.19, 510.1)
Floating mana empties (106.4); concession legal any time (104.3a)
